summary: Itron, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 regarding a cybersecurity incident discovered on April 13, 2026. The company activated its response plan, engaged external advisors, and notified law enforcement. Unauthorized activity was contained and removed, with no impact on customer-hosted systems. Operations continued materially, and insurance is expected to cover a significant portion of direct costs. The company does not currently believe the incident has had or is reasonably likely to have a material impact. This filing does not describe a special situation such as a merger, acquisition, or restructuring.
